models.name: qwen3-omni-30b-a3b-instruct

models.name: nemotron3-nano-omni-nvfp4
models.runnable_24gb: UNKNOWN -> explicit P3 blocker. NVFP4 mixed-precision (modelopt producer; quant_algo MIXED_PRECISION with NVFP4+FP8 weights, FP8 KV-cache), 21GB. Arch = NemotronH_Nano_Omni_Reasoning_V3 = NemotronH Mamba2-hybrid LM + parakeet audio encoder + radio vision. NVFP4 needs Blackwell (sm_120 present) AND an execution stack: TensorRT-LLM or vLLM+modelopt. vLLM 0.14.0 already crashes on omni multimodal processors (Inference-Engine-Choice.md); TRT-LLM support for this hybrid omni arch is unverified. No GGUF (llama.cpp supports neither NVFP4 nor NemotronH-omni). 21GB alone -> no co-residence, time-share only.
models.license: other = nvidia-open-model-agreement (NVIDIA Open Model Agreement -- permissive, commercial OK). NOTE: this is DIFFERENT from omni-embed-nemotron-3b's NVIDIA OneWay Noncommercial license -- this one is usable.
models.evidence: config.json arch=NemotronH_Nano_Omni_Reasoning_V3 (model_type parakeet/nemotron_h); hf_quant_config.json producer=modelopt quant_algo=MIXED_PRECISION NVFP4/FP8; README license nvidia-open-model-agreement
models.gaps: P3 PRIMARY BLOCKER: no verified NVFP4 execution path for this Mamba-hybrid omni arch on this box (TRT-LLM/vLLM+modelopt both unproven). If solved, it is the BEST delta_corr verifier (most architecturally divergent from Qwen3-Omni). Do not assume runnable.

models.name: minicpm-o-4_5
models.runnable_24gb: HF transformers bf16 safetensors ~19GB (4 shards), custom arch MiniCPMO (trust_remote_code: modeling_minicpmo.py present) = MiniCPM LLM + whisper-medium audio encoder + siglip vision, init_audio=True. Fits on 24GB ALONE (tight) but no co-residence with llama-server -> GPU time-share. MiniCPM-o family has had upstream llama.cpp GGUF support historically (2.6), but NO GGUF for 4.5 on disk and 4.5 GGUF support is unverified. Earlier offline failure ('driver hardcodes Qwen3-Omni arch', Inference-Engine-Choice.md) was a runner-script issue, not the model.
models.evidence: config.json arch=MiniCPMO, audio_config present, whisper-medium audio; README license apache-2.0; Inference-Engine-Choice.md L28-30
models.gaps: DELTA_CORR: independent lineage (MiniCPM LLM + Whisper audio, NOT Qwen) -> stronger decorrelation than moss, weaker-arch-divergence than nemotron. P3: HF custom-arch omni load not yet verified running; no 4.5 GGUF; time-share only.
